description: Listings submitted, launched and declined on Neeed Directory per UTC month, oldest first, through the current month, which is marked incomplete. Launched counts the listings of each month that are live now, so every month is marked estimated. The data is CC BY 4.0: show the attribution line with it.
name: get_launch_stats

complete.description: False for the current month, which is still under way

declined.description: Listings whose rejection that month still stands

launched.description: Listings submitted that month that are live now

submitted.description: Listings submitted that month and still on record

attribution.description: The credit line to show with the data

months.description: Oldest first, through the current month

source.description: The page that publishes the data

title: Get launch stats
